Booking Policies

Please read before booking.

Deposit

A $100 TT deposit is required to secure every appointment. Deposits are non-refundable and non-transferable.

Late Arrivals

A $40 TT late fee will be added when you are more than 20 minutes late.

25-Minute Limit

After 25 minutes late, the appointment will be cancelled. The $100 deposit will not be refunded or transferred.

No Extra Guests

No extra guests are permitted. Please attend your appointment alone.

Nail Art & Bling

All prices are base prices. No excessive nail art or excessive bling is included in the base price.

Appointments

Appointments are required. Please arrive on time and communicate as soon as possible if you need to make a change.
